name: normalized-0-1000
note: captured from a real run: normalizedCoordinateToPixel(value, axis) = round(value / 1000 * (axis - 1)), so 500/500 on 1080x2316 becomes (round(0.5 * 1079), round(0.5 * 2315)) = (540, 1158), the pixels nearest the screen centre (539.5, 1157.5). The naive 'keep the normalized number as pixels' reading, (500, 500), is what the first run disproved.
